title: Authority Order Stop Condition
description: Draft AI governance instance recording that unresolved authority conflict is a stop condition, not a reason to infer semantics.
aiGuidance: AI-generated output is operational assistance only. USF semantics, ADRs, validators, and proof evidence define truth.
rationale: The Charter and Authority Model require agents to stop rather than invent behaviour when semantic authority is missing or contradictory.
stopConditions: source evidence contradicts accepted USF semantics
task requires implementation code without approved directive
authority conflict cannot be resolved safely
driftRisks: historical source path treated as future target path
